entries.zh: 姆：叔伯舅之妻的称谓（伯母／舅母类，闽南呼“阿姆”）；旧义亦指乳母、保姆。
entries.en: sister-in-law, woman/wife; per the Chinese 姆 (Hokkien a-im): an uncle's wife (aunt), older sense a wet-nurse or governess.
entries.notes: 两栏音调均污损（T99）且音写存疑（im/in），据汉字“姆”与词头 cunada 定为伯母／舅母类称谓。

entries.zh: 妗：舅母（舅父之妻）。
entries.en: sister-in-law; per the Chinese 妗: wife of one's maternal uncle.
entries.notes: 汉字栏妗/姈与官话对音均有[疑]，义项按通行义定为舅母。

entries.zh: 姨：姨母（母之姊妹）；亦指妻之姊妹（姨子）。
entries.en: sister-in-law; per the Chinese 姨: maternal aunt, also a wife's sister.
entries.notes: 自动重建注记称稿中传教士音写栏空缺、与所录 ȳ 相抵触，故降级；字义据汉字与官话对音明确。

entries.zh: 舅（稿作“旧”）：舅父（母之兄弟）；亦指妻之兄弟（内舅）。
entries.en: male brother-in-law (cuñado varón); per the Chinese 舅: maternal uncle, also a wife's brother.

entries.zh: 姐夫：姊夫（姐姐之夫）。
entries.en: sister-in-law term: husband of the elder sister.
entries.notes: 音写栏音调污损（T99），字义四栏互证明确。

entries.zh: 嫂：兄嫂（哥哥之妻）。
entries.en: sister-in-law of the elder brother: the elder brother's wife.

entries.zh: 厶舅（首字存疑，或作“么”）：妻党姊妹辈舅亲之称，释义存疑；西文栏释作“妻之姊妹”。
entries.en: uncertain wife's-side in-law term (first character unclear); the Spanish gloss reads “sister of my wife”.
entries.notes: 首字有疑且汉字栏与两栏音写相互不合，仅能概述其妻党姻亲属性。

entries.zh: 妻兄：妻之兄（大舅子）。
entries.en: sister-in-law term of my wife; per the Chinese 妻兄: the wife's elder brother.
entries.notes: 两栏音调污损（T99），字义据汉字栏与西文栏明确。

entries.zh: 引姆（首字存疑，或作“姻”）：疑为“姻姆/亲姆”类姻亲母辈称谓（亲家母）；西文栏释作“妻之大姨”，两栏不合。
entries.en: uncertain affinity term (姻姆/亲姆, likely co-mother-in-law); the Spanish gloss instead reads “my elder sister-in-law”.
entries.notes: 汉字与音写均有疑且两栏语义相抵触，无法定夺，降为低置信。

entries.zh: 妹夫：妹妹之夫。
entries.en: sister-in-law term: husband of the younger sister.
entries.notes: 官话栏音调污损（T99），字义四栏互证明确。

entries.zh: 妹婿：妹夫（妹妹之夫）。
entries.en: sister-in-law term: husband of the younger sister (妹婿).
entries.notes: 官话栏音调污损（T99），字义四栏互证明确。

entries.zh: 舅妗：舅父与舅母（一对舅夫妇）之合称；西文栏谓分娶姊妹二人之两连襟。
entries.en: per the Spanish: two brothers-in-law married to two sisters, etc.; per the Chinese 舅妗: maternal uncle and his wife.
entries.notes: 西文栏释义与汉字栏不合（夫妇一对 vs 两连襟），字义以汉字栏为准。

entries.zh: 舅兄嫂：妻党兄长之妻（兄嫂之属），冠“舅”字属妻党；西文栏作“兄长之妻”。
entries.en: sister-in-law of the elder brother: the wife's elder brother's wife.

entries.zh: 细舅（稿作“細旧”）：最年幼的舅父（细舅／幼舅）；或谓妻之幼弟（小舅子）。
entries.en: sister-in-law of the younger sibling: the youngest uncle (细舅), or the wife's youngest brother.
entries.notes: 官话栏音调污损（T99）；“旧”为“舅”稿字，舅字本义（母之弟）与西文栏妻党义并存，以汉字栏为主。

entries.zh: 妻舅（稿作“妻旧”）：妻之兄弟（内兄内弟）。
entries.en: full sibling of my wife; per the Chinese 妻舅: the wife's brother.
entries.notes: 音写栏污损（T99）；西文栏 cunada 或为 cunado 之误读，以汉字栏妻舅为准。

entries.zh: 表舅：表舅父（母之表兄弟）；泛指表辈舅亲。
entries.en: brothers-in-law married to [one word struck out] of my wife; per the Chinese 表舅: mother's male cousin (cousin uncle).
entries.notes: 西文栏 baxienta 一词被划去，系稿面涂改，不影响表舅之义。

entries.zh: 妻兄：妻之兄（大舅子）；与第 8 条同词重出。
entries.en: in-law (hermano/hermana) of my wife; per the Chinese 妻兄: the wife's elder brother.
entries.notes: 两栏音调污损（T99），字义明确，与第 8 条重复立目。

entries.zh: 二妗：二舅母（排行第二的舅父之妻）。
entries.en: sister-in-law, wife of the second brother; per the Chinese 二妗: second maternal uncle's wife.
entries.notes: 官话栏音调污损（T99），字义据汉字栏与排行定。

entries.zh: 三妗：三舅母（排行第三的舅父之妻）。
entries.en: sister-in-law, wife of the third brother; per the Chinese 三妗: third maternal uncle's wife.
entries.notes: 官话栏音调污损（T99），字义据汉字栏与排行定。

entries.zh: 大妗：大舅母（排行最长的舅父之妻）。
entries.en: sister-in-law, wife of the eldest brother; per the Chinese 大妗: eldest maternal uncle's wife.

entries.zh: 哥嫂：哥哥与嫂子／大哥之妻（首字存疑）。
entries.en: sister-in-law, wife of the eldest brother; per the Chinese 哥嫂: elder brother and his wife (first character uncertain).
entries.notes: 汉字栏首字有疑（哥/亩），义据西文栏“最长兄之妻”定为哥嫂。

entries.zh: 细妗（稿作“細妗”）：最年幼的舅父之妻（小妗）。
entries.en: sister-in-law, wife of the youngest brother; per the Chinese 细妗: youngest maternal uncle's wife.
entries.notes: 官话栏音调污损（T99），与大妗、二妗、三妗同属妗之排行系列。
